svg.text: VELA · THE KEPT LIGHT · SOFT ARCH · GEOMETRY EXPLORATION AND THE LOCKED MARK · 2026-09-12
A · ARCH RADIUS (ACROSS) × TRANSOM HEIGHT (DOWN) · FRAME 11, MUNTIN 6
r 26 is a rounded card; r 42 is nearly the church arch again. 34 keeps the arch readable at 24 px and the top pane wide enough for the light.
Transom at 36% pinches the top panes; at 44% the four panes start to look equal, and equal panes read as a plus. 40% is the sash window.
9 disappears in one colour at 32 px; 13 gets heavy next to the wordmark. 11 with muntins at 6 keeps a 1.8:1 hierarchy.
Window 100 × 132 · arch radius 34 · bottom radius 14 · frame 11 · muntins 6 · transom 40% · wordmark Literata SemiBold, cap height 62% of the mark, gap 27%, baseline 5% above the mark's foot
Clear space: half the mark's height on every side. Minimum: 32 px with muntins, 16 px simplified (no muntins, frame 16).
D · THE THREE STATES AND THE SMALL MARK
